description:
Most people won’t notice you.
And the few who do? They’ll forget in 30 seconds.

And yes… I literally set up my camera in the middle of the terminal and filmed this.

Something I definitely would have thought was cringe before.

But here’s what changed—
I stopped making “don’t be embarrassing” the goal…
and started making “be free” the goal.

I used to overthink everything in public—
how I looked, what people thought, if I was being too much.

Now?

I’d rather be “too much” than hold myself back.

This is your reminder:
👉 You’re allowed to take up space
👉 You’re allowed to be seen
👉 You’re allowed to stop shrinking

Try it. Do something slightly uncomfortable in public today.

You’ll see that literally nobody cares. 👌🏻

Comment DONE 👇🏻 if you’re ready to be done with caring too much what random people think about you — I’ll send you my easy-to-implement system that will help

#stopcaring confidencemindset
